title: Look far away
text: Find something about 6 metres (20 feet) away and rest your eyes on it until the timer ends.

title: Blink slowly
text: We blink less while reading a screen. Close your eyes fully and slowly, ten times.

title: Out the window
text: Look out the nearest window and find the farthest thing you can see.

title: Small breaks count
text: Breaks of under ten minutes lift energy and lower fatigue. Take this one fully.

title: Drop your shoulders
text: Let your shoulders fall, unclench your jaw and breathe out slowly. Twice.

title: Posture check
text: Shift how you are sitting, and check the screen sits just below eye level.
source_title: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety

title: Shoulder rolls
text: Roll your shoulders backwards five times, slowly.

title: Three breaths
text: Close your eyes and take three slow breaths, longer out than in.

title: Open hands
text: Spread your fingers wide, then make a loose fist. Five times.

title: Look over your shoulder
text: Turn your head slowly to look over one shoulder, then the other.

title: Go for a short walk
text: Light walking breaks during long sitting lower blood sugar and insulin after meals. Walk until the timer ends.

title: Water, the long way
text: Refill your glass of water and take the longest route back.

title: Ten slow squats
text: Stand up and do ten slow squats or ten calf raises. Hold the desk if you like.

title: One flight
text: Climb a flight of stairs and come back down.

title: Reach and lean
text: Reach both arms overhead, then lean gently to each side. Hold each for about ten seconds.
source_title: Canadian Centre for Occupational Health and Safety

title: Break up sitting
text: Two minutes of light walking every 20 minutes lowered blood sugar and insulin compared with sitting straight through.

title: Step away
text: Leave the screen. Stand at a window, stretch, and let your eyes rest on the distance.

title: Tidy one thing
text: Stand up and put away three things around you.
